enhancements.text: Gravis model only. Attacks against this unit with Strength higher than its Toughness get -1 to wound.

enhancements.name: Relentless Advance
enhancements.text: Gravis model only. This unit has Scouts 5".

dark-angels-gravis-linebreaker-force.name: Gravis Linebreaker Force
dark-angels-gravis-linebreaker-force.ruleText: In a turn a friendly Gravis unit made a normal move, its ranged attacks lose [HEAVY] and get +1 to hit.

stratagems.name: Annihilating Force
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Gravis unit is picked to attack.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

stratagems.name: Purgation Push
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, after a friendly Gravis unit has shot.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: If unengaged, it makes a normal move of up to 5" and must end within range of an objective. It can't charge or embark this turn.

stratagems.name: Armoured Impact
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Gravis unit ends a charge move.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Pick an engaged enemy unit and roll a D6 per model engaged with it: each 3+ inflicts 1 mortal wound.

enhancements.name: Master-forged Firearms
enhancements.text: Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted model only. This model's ranged attacks (not [PSYCHIC]) get +1 Attacks, Strength, AP and Damage.

enhancements.name: Honour of Vigilance
enhancements.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. This unit's ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS]; while the devastator doctrine is active for it, it can re-roll advance rolls.

dark-angels-devastator-brethren.name: Devastator Brethren
dark-angels-devastator-brethren.ruleText: You can pick the devastator doctrine one extra time per battle.

stratagems.name: Hail of Vengeance
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy's shooting destroys a model in a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: It shoots back, targeting only that enemy unit.

stratagems.name: Storm of Fire
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is picked to shoot.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged attacks have [IGNORES COVER] (and +1 AP if the devastator doctrine is active).

stratagems.name: Armour of Contempt
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: -1 AP on attacks against it until that enemy has attacked.

enhancements.name: Beacon Angelis
enhancements.text: Adeptus Astartes model only. If this is a Kill Team unit, it has Deep Strike and Rapid Ingress costs 1 CP less for it.

dark-angels-deathwatch-support.name: Deathwatch Support
dark-angels-deathwatch-support.ruleText: Friendly Kill Team units gain: [SUSTAINED HITS 1] while the devastator doctrine is active; [LETHAL HITS] while the tactical doctrine is active; [PRECISION] against enemies within 9" while the assault doctrine is active. You can include up to 500 points of Deathwatch units; they can't be your Warlord and Kill Teams can only take enhancements from this detachment.

stratagems.name: Dragonfire Rounds
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a Kill Team unit is picked to shoot.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged attacks can re-roll wound rolls of 1 and have [IGNORES COVER].

stratagems.name: Kraken Rounds
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a Kill Team unit is picked to shoot.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged attacks get +6" range and +1 Strength.

stratagems.name: Blackstar Extraction
stratagems.text:
WHEN: End of your opponent's Fight phase.
TARGET: A friendly unengaged Kill Team unit.
EFFECT: Place it in strategic reserves.

stratagems.name: Hellfire Rounds
stratagems.text:
WHEN: Your Shooting phase, when a Kill Team unit is picked to shoot.
TARGET: That unit.
EFFECT: Its ranged attacks (not [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]) have [ANTI-NON-VEHICLE 4+].

dark-angels.name: Combat Doctrines
dark-angels.text: At the start of your Command phase you can pick one combat doctrine; it's active for your Adeptus Astartes units with this ability until your next Command phase. Each doctrine can normally be picked once per battle, and a unit can only have one doctrine active (a new one replaces the old). Assault Doctrine: advancing doesn't stop the unit charging. Devastator Doctrine: ranged attacks gain [ASSAULT]. Tactical Doctrine: falling back doesn't stop the unit shooting or charging.

dark-angels.name: Transhuman Strategist
dark-angels.text: At the start of each battle round, if a model with this ability is your Warlord, gain 1 CP.

dark-angels.name: Librarius
dark-angels.text: Adeptus Astartes Psyker units have a psyker level (shown in their abilities) and each psychic ability has a psychic level in its name. Each battle round, a Psyker can use psychic abilities whose combined level doesn't exceed its psyker level. Using one usually means rolling a D6: on a 1 the unit becomes battle-shocked.
